source: Transcribed by hand from the C3z labels of Fig. 2c (tWSe2) and Fig. 2d (tMoTe2) of arXiv:2311.12776v3 (= Nat. Commun. 15, 4223 (2024)), read from a 450-dpi rendering of page 2. Each entry lists the K-valley spin-up eigenvalue of moire valence bands 1, 2, 3 (band 1 = topmost) at the point; the figure gives the spin-down (K') partner of every doublet as the complex conjugate (|up, xi> with |down, xi*>, |up, -1> with |down, -1>). Caption: the C3z eigenvalue is the same at kappa and kappa'. Notation: xi = exp(i pi/3), xis = exp(-i pi/3), m1 = -1.
